scope: Local-only observability changes in a new private candidate; no new SSH/native/unit execution
changes: Record real launcher exit and wait completion even after EPIPE; keep poll/kill/wait cleanup errors separate
Collect only owned stderr after observed launcher exit, under the existing 4096-byte and phase-deadline limits; expose closed prefix categories, byte count and EOF only

findings.detail: Stderr may remain blocking when selector or earlier set_blocking initialization fails; no safe drain without re-establishing nonblocking mode.
A final unprotected proc.poll can discard collected primary, wait and cleanup evidence in the confirmed owner branch.

previousActualFailureRootCause: Unknown; previous 159 stderr bytes were not preserved and synthetic prefix tests do not supply that missing evidence.
nextDecision: Authorize only local nonblocking-drain and final-poll evidence-boundary corrections plus regression; no SSH, new units or publication.
